typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	Archive_Folder_Path as string (),
	Date as string (),
	DBPassword as string (),
	DBServerName as string (),
	Email_Message as string (),
	Email_Message_Line as string (),
	Email_Recipients as string (),
	Extract_Run_Date as string (),
	Failure_Email_Recipients as string (),
	FileName_CM as string (),
	FileName_PA as string (),
	InitialCatalog as string (),
	Outbound_Folder_Path as string (),
	UserName as string (),
	v_FileName as string (),
	v_File_Name_DETAILS as string ()
}

source(output(
		CARE_MANAGER as string,
		CM_STATUS as string,
		MEMBER_ID as string,
		CARE_MANAGER_FNAME as string,
		CARE_MANAGER_LNAME as string,
		CARE_MANAGER_PHONE as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT  [MEMBER_ID]       ,[CARE_MANAGER]       ,[CARE_MANAGER_LNAME]       ,[CARE_MANAGER_FNAME]       ,[CARE_MANAGER_PHONE]       ,[CM_STATUS]   FROM [DATA_EXCHANGE].[EXTRACT].[OH_MyCare_TOC_CARE_MANAGEMENT]  WHERE [file_name]  = ?   ORDER BY 3',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> SourceOHMyCareTOCCAREMANAGEMENT
SourceOHMyCareTOCCAREMANAGEMENT sink(input(
		CARE_MANAGER as string,
		CM_STATUS as string,
		MEMBER_ID as string,
		CARE_MANAGER_FNAME as string,
		CARE_MANAGER_LNAME as string,
		CARE_MANAGER_PHONE as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		CARE_MANAGER,
		CM_STATUS,
		MEMBER_ID,
		CARE_MANAGER_FNAME,
		CARE_MANAGER_LNAME,
		CARE_MANAGER_PHONE)) ~> FlatFileCareManagement
